tools.name: recruitment-operations_job-description-structure
tools.description: Read Title, Requirement, and Responsibility lines into explicit requirements. Unlabeled prose is not turned into a requirement, and a requirement counts toward a score only when it is marked required. Price $0.03 USDC. tools.name: recruitment-operations_resume-data-extract
tools.description: Read Skill, Role, and Qualification lines. Personal-attribute lines and references are ignored and are not stored. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/recruitment-operations/resume-data-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: recruitment-operations_resume-job-match
tools.description: Compare supplied skills, qualifications, and role dates with explicit required items. A caller alias is marked inferred. A responsibility is not marked met. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/recruitment-operations/resume-job-match. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: recruitment-operations_candidate-skill-compare
tools.description: Compare supplied skill names across candidates and against an explicit skill list. Missing skills are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/recruitment-operations/candidate-skill-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: recruitment-operations_candidate-experience-validate
tools.description: Check supplied employment dates for invalid dates, overlaps, and gaps. Dates are not rewritten, and a gap is not a ranking penalty. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/recruitment-operations/candidate-experience-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: recruitment-operations_interview-question-generate
tools.description: Draft questions from missing required items, inferred alias matches, and job responsibilities. The questions do not score the candidate. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/recruitment-operations/interview-question-generate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: recruitment-operations_candidate-shortlist-rank
tools.description: Score candidates only from explicit required matches. An exact match is worth 2 and a caller alias is worth 1. Ties keep the caller's order. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/recruitment-operations/candidate-shortlist-rank. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: recruitment-operations_pipeline-report
tools.description: Combine the job requirements, resume facts, match explanations, experience checks, interview prompts, and shortlist scores. The report is not a hiring decision. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/recruitment-operations/pipeline-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "recruitment-operations" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recruitment-operations_job-description-structure, recruitment-operations_resume-data-extract, recruitment-operations_candidate-skill-compare, recruitment-operations_candidate-experience-validate · Public sink: recruitment-operations_job-description-structure, recruitment-operations_resume-data-extract, recruitment-operations_resume-job-match, recruitment-operations_candidate-skill-compare, recruitment-operations_candidate-experience-validate, recruitment-operations_interview-question-generate, recruitment-operations_candidate-shortlist-rank, recruitment-operations_pipeline-report · Destructive: recruitment-operations_job-description-structure, recruitment-operations_resume-data-extract, recruitment-operations_resume-job-match, recruitment-operations_candidate-skill-compare, recruitment-operations_candidate-experience-validate, recruitment-operations_interview-question-generate, recruitment-operations_candidate-shortlist-rank, recruitment-operations_pipeline-report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recruitment-operations_job-description-structure, recruitment-operations_resume-data-extract, recruitment-operations_candidate-skill-compare, recruitment-operations_candidate-experience-validate · Public sink: recruitment-operations_job-description-structure, recruitment-operations_resume-data-extract, recruitment-operations_resume-job-match, recruitment-operations_candidate-skill-compare, recruitment-operations_candidate-experience-validate, recruitment-operations_interview-question-generate, recruitment-operations_candidate-shortlist-rank, recruitment-operations_pipeline-report · Destructive: recruitment-operations_job-description-structure, recruitment-operations_resume-data-extract, recruitment-operations_resume-job-match, recruitment-operations_candidate-skill-compare, recruitment-operations_candidate-experience-validate, recruitment-operations_interview-question-generate, recruitment-operations_candidate-shortlist-rank, recruitment-operations_pipeline-report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
